decision: Freeze C12 for independent assessment; not full utility acceptance or release approval
rationale: Equivalent scoped SQL repair has deterministic regression checks and repeated HTTP evidence, without a new ranking rule.
Full implementation checks and paired development provenance complete. Native issue Top-1 and nDCG, main/heldout relation coverage, and CSN improve; primary Hit@3 and test recall are retained.
Proceed to the preselected case-disjoint validation to assess generalisation without further development tuning.
unwaived_failures: Short Top-1 loses 15/240 and MRR decreases; this exceeds the pre-existing tolerance. Fourteen heads have independently audited same-file uses that the frozen truth excludes; one is Flask prose. Frozen scores and labels remain unchanged.

Main-project Top-1 loses 2/35, beyond its existing one-case tolerance: a valid same-file consumer leads for one case, while a type test leads the preferred runtime test for the other. Six correlated variants repeat the latter loss.
Upstream relation recall, short path recall, native diagnostic core-region recall, and several semantic strata decrease.
runtime_limits: Both sources emit one dense warm-up failure warning.

The baseline emits one exact-symbol timeout, associated by sequential request order with development case pylint-dev__pylint-7080. Primary and nDCG values match C12; its counterfactual full-response effect is unknown.
C12 has zero observed symbol/lexical timeout and connection-cleanup warnings. HTTP success alone does not imply complete evidence.
Moving 24-hour usage-counter deltas are INVALID for token, cost and call comparisons, including positive deltas.
validation_policy: Keep source fixed; run both 18-case case-disjoint batches on overlapping repositories and the previously aggregate-exposed 20-case regression; inspect only aggregates after both sources complete; no tuning on validation outcomes.
